execution.objective: Propose a bounded authority for issuing a release contract and attempting restoration of the Founder-approved admin dashboard candidate using the verified-feature runner.
success_criteria: This authority becomes active only after its authority PR is approved and merged.
Update the runner to validate the active WCS dynamically rather than requiring WCS-003.
Create a digest-bound release contract and manifest for the exact candidate and 11 application paths.
Run restoration only in an isolated runner-created worktree.
Run the build, targeted API test, browser test, and baseline-versus-restored TypeScript comparison.
Create a restoration review PR only after all required checks pass.
Require Founder verification of signed-in administrator workflows and a read-only Development template fingerprint comparison.
Never merge the restoration PR, deploy, publish, or modify database records.
execution.verification_profile: SUCCESSOR_AUTHORITY; CONTRACT_BINDING; EXACT_PATH_SCOPE; ISOLATED_RESTORATION; BUILD_API_BROWSER_CHECKS; FOUNDER_VERIFICATION; NO_MERGE_OR_DEPLOY

typecheck_comparison.acceptance: Compare diagnostics from the exact target baseline and restored candidate; fail if the restored candidate introduces any new TypeScript errors.

execution.target_baseline_rule: At runner invocation, bind the restoration target baseline to the then-current origin/main SHA and record it in the manifest.
release_contract_requirements: Bind the contract to candidate baseline 90e044eb811b6370b1144833fd2b88cafd89aa02.
List exactly the 11 approved application paths.
List the required build, API, and browser checks.
Compare TypeScript diagnostics on the target baseline and restored candidate; reject any new errors.

forbidden_surface: Merge, publication, or deployment of the restored application
Application paths outside the exact 11-path candidate list
Cleanup outside temporary worktrees created by this runner

test_definition: Confirm contract absence or mismatch stops before target mutation.
Confirm exact-path enforcement and cleanup of runner-created temporary worktrees.
Review build, API, browser, and TypeScript comparison evidence.
Sign in as an administrator and verify the Prospects and Notification Templates workflows.
Compare Development notification-template fingerprints before and after; do not edit records.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Founder records PASS or REJECTED before any separate release decision.
